rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person with little or no hair on the head.

example.english: My uncle has been bald for many years.
example.traditional: 我個阿叔已經禿頭好多年喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 aa3 suk1 ji5 ging1 tuk1 tau4 hou2 do1 nin4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a visibly bare head, including one that has been shaved.

example.english: He shaved his head, and now he is bald with a visibly bare scalp.
example.traditional: 佢剃咗光頭，而家個頭真係好光。
example.jyutping: keoi5 tai3 zo2 gwong1 tau4 ji4 gaa1 go3 tau4 zan1 hai6 hou2 gwong1

rows.note: Use this for an animal or body part lacking fur, feathers, or hair rather than specifically a bald scalp.

example.english: This bald chicken looks so funny.
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 mou5 mou4 ge3 gai1 hou2 gaau2 siu3

rows.note: Use this everyday descriptive wording when simply stressing that someone has no hair on the head.

example.english: They are bald even though they are still young.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 hau6 saang1 zau6 mou5 tau4 faat3 laa3
